predictions.blurb: UCLA made the week's biggest leap, jumping from 21st to 12th, though the advanced numbers haven't caught up — SP+ has the Bruins 18th and FPI a skeptical 37th.
LSU tumbled from 10th to 22nd in the poll, but the models haven't abandoned the Tigers at all: SP+ still has them ninth and FPI eighth, the widest gap between perception and projection on the board.
Kentucky enters the rankings at No. 15 after being unranked, and it's the metrics that are unconvinced — SP+ ranks the Wildcats 46th, FPI 30th.
Mississippi State nudged up a spot to 16th, with SP+ (28th) and FPI (27th) in rare agreement that the Bulldogs are rated a bit ahead of where the numbers see them.
Oklahoma State held steady at No. 18, with SP+ reasonably close at 22nd and FPI the outlier at 42nd.

fieldStorylines.blurb: The Big Ten's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 4 Ohio State leads No. 5 Indiana by a single spot — and they play each other this week.
BYU holds the Big 12's automatic bid at No. 8 with No. 10 Texas Tech two spots back, close enough that one bad Saturday flips the order.
Georgia sits atop the SEC at No. 1 with No. 6 Alabama the nearest chaser, a five-spot cushion that's the most comfortable conference lead of the three.
